meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says ulw-execute, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的计划分解并并行执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已有一份清晰计划,想让多个助手协作把它落地。
copy.tagline_en: Break a prepared plan into parallel execution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a clear plan and want assistants to carry it out together.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 只做调度：它把计划拆成小任务，派多个子代理并行写代码、测试、复核，自己只更新进度和检查结果。全部勾选完成才收工；也可以指定每阶段做成拉取请求或一直跟进到合并。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-execute”“execute plan”“continue plan”等，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发；若没有现成计划而你说“start work”，它会先引导生成计划再执行。

say.text: 执行 .omo/plans 里的重构计划，用 --make-pr 模式。
say.note: 它拆成小任务交给子代理，每阶段交付一个拉取请求。

say.text: 继续当前计划，从上次停下的地方接着干。
用 --ship 跑完整个计划，合并完成前别停。
say.note: --ship 会持续处理 CI 失败和评审意见直到合并。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: never codes/edits files itself; selects plans, updates state, delegates every implementation/QA/review step to parallel subagents until all checkboxes are done. --make-pr yields per-phase PRs; --ship stays until merged.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'ulw-execute', 'execute plan', or 'continue plan', or when asked to run a .omo/plans plan. If no plan exists and 'start work' is said, it bootstraps one via ulw-plan first.

say_en.text: Run the refactoring plan in .omo/plans with --make-pr.
say_en.note: It delegates to subagents and delivers a PR per phase.

say_en.text: Continue the current plan from where it stopped.
say_en.note: It resumes unchecked work from Boulder state.

say_en.text: Run the full plan with --ship; don't stop until merged.
say_en.note: --ship handles CI and review until each PR merges.
